scope: Partial source review of twelve ordinary seating banks. Main ordinary bank separated approximately from OSM roof using designer photographs; numerical risers, treads and inset are estimates. Does not certify complete 2026 inventory, Platinum, accessible platforms, Fan areas or GA.

rowCountSource.notes: Independent visitor guide seating chart maximum row label; not an organizer survey or 2026 ticket inventory certification. Ordinary main seating bank only; separate five-row Platinum upper product is not modeled by this profile. Existing OSM building footprint remains approximate for usable seats.

riseSource.notes: 17 ordinary rows from the independent chart, applied only after separating an approximate ordinary seating strip from the building roof. Riser 0.4m (0.3–0.5m range), total rise6.4m is estimated; tread0.85m and front inset6m are separately documented photo-informed estimates. Platinum balcony remains separate and unmodeled. This configuration is defined from seating evidence, never optimized for raycast clearance.

source.notes: Designer photographs of the completed 2025 main grandstand, especially project-hungaroring-01/02/08/10.jpg, distinguish the ordinary sloping bank from the roof and rear Platinum balcony. Existing OSM building is NOT usable seating. Ordinary bank is an explicit approximate strip: 6m behind the track-facing building edge (plausible 4–8m), 17 rows x 0.85m assumed tread depth (plausible 0.70–1.00m), total 14.45m. Longitudinal ends follow the source building. These dimensions are photo-informed modeling estimates, not a survey or digitized architect plan; aisles and irregular block ends omitted. The full source building boundary is retained separately; no primary photographs are bundled.

Ground datum sampled from the unchanged GEDTM30 grid at the ordinary bank front midpoint. The front-floor base remains the existing estimated 2.2m above this ground, rather than above the uphill roof/building centroid. Does not change DEM, road elevation, eye height or vehicle physics; 30m grid cannot resolve the foundation or front longitudinal grade.

riseSource.notes: 16 rows from the independent guide. Riser assumed 0.40m (range 0.30–0.50m); total rise (16-1)*0.40m. Replaces bounding-box inferred rows/rise. Ground datum, front floor, footprint and all real obstacles remain unchanged. No height is chosen to pass a raycast.
